# TECHNAVIA

> TECHNAVIA (technaviatechnology.com) is a B2B web engineering, Technical SEO, LLM Visibility (AEO/GEO), and Custom AI Automation studio based in Surat, Gujarat, India serving global clients — distinct from Technavio market research.

TECHNAVIA (https://technaviatechnology.com) is a high-performance B2B Web Engineering and AI Automation studio turning corporate websites into high-ranking search assets, LLM-cited knowledge entities, and autonomous lead-to-CRM automation engines.

## The 3 Core Services

### 1. Web Development + Technical SEO
- Outcome: Sub-second Next.js builds engineered to rank on Google from day one.
- Deliverables: React 19 Server Components, zero client-side hydration bloat, semantic HTML5, Schema.org knowledge graphs (Organization, Service, WebSite), 100% source code ownership.
- Canonical URL: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/web-development-seo

### 2. LLM Visibility (AEO / GEO)
- Outcome: Get cited when high-intent B2B buyers search your category on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude & Perplexity.
- Deliverables: 3-layer citation architecture (Organization + Service JSON-LD Graph -> Quotable Answer-Capsules -> Bot Crawl Directives & IndexNow).
- Canonical URL: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/llm-visibility

### 3. Custom AI Automations
- Outcome: Sub-60s lead response, automated qualification, and zero busywork.
- Deliverables: Production n8n workflows, Clearbit/Apollo data enrichment, LLM ICP scoring, dynamic calendar booking links, two-way CRM sync (HubSpot/Salesforce), and Slack alerts.
- Canonical URL: https://technaviatechnology.com/services/ai-automations
